severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — CULINARY IMAGERY INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: SYNTHETIC-FOOD FRONT MAKES LANDFALL AS GLISTENING IMPOSSIBLE MEALS CROSS FROM THE FEED ONTO REAL MENUS, CAFÉ FACADES, AND SIDEWALK BOARDS, DEPICTING BURGERS WITH ELEVEN PATTIES AND A GLOW NO KITCHEN CAN LEGALLY PRODUCE
advisory: The Service has upgraded conditions to a Heavy Slop Warning following confirmed migration of synthetic food imagery out of the feed and onto physical storefronts. Residents approaching a café should be advised that a pictured pastry rendered with impossible symmetry, wet sheen, and roughly one-and-a-half too many layers may not correspond to any object available for purchase inside. Order verbally where possible. The dish will taste of ordinary food, which after such a photograph may register as disappointment.

regional_outlook.conditions: Recipe imagery continues to glisten unnaturally under a high-saturation ridge. Thumbnails of soup depict steam rising from a bowl that contains no soup.
A newly monitored region. Sidewalk sandwich boards report synthetic bagels with drifting sesame and a golden light source located inside the bread itself.
Heavy sharing of 'look at this incredible café' posts featuring establishments that photograph beautifully and exist nowhere. Reservation lines ring into the void.
Scattered synthetic bakery listings show cakes with impossible frosting geometry. Buyers advised the received cake will have the correct number of dimensions.
Delivery-app hero images continue to depict meals that arrive smaller, browner, and considerably more real than advertised. Expectations trending downward.

specimen.status: Escaped population; now breeding on physical signage.
specimen.habitat: Bodega windows, café facades, delivery-app banners, and any menu recently 'refreshed' for free.
specimen.field_marks: Excessive internal glow with no visible light source; a patty count that increases the longer you look; cheese suspended mid-drip in defiance of gravity; sesame seeds that appear to be gently exhaling; a lettuce leaf translucent in a way lettuce has never been.
specimen.call: Fresh Daily • Made With Love • Now Serving — Now Serving — Now Serving
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for an actual photograph of the actual food. Tell them apart by counting: real burgers have a fixed number of patties, and real steam obeys the local weather.

spotter_tip: When a food image looks better than food is physically permitted to look, count the sesame seeds twice — if the total changes, do not attempt to eat the picture.
tomorrow: Synthetic sheen persists into Wednesday; residents advised to trust the smell over the render.

confirmed_sighting.report: Surreal AI-generated food images have begun crossing from social feeds into the physical world, appearing on the menus and facades of bodegas, cafés, and restaurants. The Service notes real-world backlash, including a San Francisco coffee shop that reportedly paid to remove protest graffiti tied to its use of AI food imagery.
